integrity: Mathematical proof and a reproducible finite supporting checker are provided. A wider, already published random-barycenter limit theorem may implicitly imply portions of the claim; this remains an originality risk. Finite experiments cannot certify an infinite-dimensional limit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive tumble-to-trap ratio, no translational diffusion, independent isotropic reorientations, and dimension tending to infinity; no joint fast-tumbling or growing-thermal-noise statement. The source contains exact finite-dimensional radial moment relations and the underlying Dirichlet-process representation.
title: High-dimensional radial fluctuations of harmonically trapped run-and-tumble particles
